operators.name: gelu_forward

parameters.name: x
parameters.shape: same as reference input, supports arbitrary strides

semantics: Computes the Gaussian Error Linear Unit (GELU) activation function element-wise.
Equivalent to PyTorch F.gelu(x) with the default approximate='none' setting.
Preserves input shape, dtype, device, and stride (output contiguous).

operators.name: trunc_forward

parameters.name: x
parameters.shape: same as reference input, supports arbitrary strides

semantics: Computes the truncation of input values toward zero, element-wise.
Preserves input shape, dtype, device, and stride (output contiguous).
Apply GELU activation function element-wise with default approximation.
Input and output are CUDA float32 tensors of shape [16, 5120, 2560].
Input is result of step_001, output tensor of same shape and dtype.
Return the final tensor after gelu and trunc operations.
Final tensor shape [16, 5120, 2560], dtype torch.float32, device cuda:0.
